lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he use to do that with?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What happened to the paper towel?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Can you describe the knife for us?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well it was like that long.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Big head on it like that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Big head on it. (Brendan nods “yes”) What kinda, I mean was it like a, a steak knife or like something you’d use for a deer?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Somethin’ like that like a deer.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, what color was the handle?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Black. And it was a, could you draw that? You think you could draw the knife?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why don’t you do that, draw me the knife.
